# M0-c-02 — closing check of consolidation round C1 (lane `check/M0-c-02-consolidate-close-1`, flow flow-7, stage group S, 2026-10-12)

**The seat and the machine.**

* Lane `check/M0-c-02-consolidate-close-1` ran under Opus 5.5 in Claude Code on 2026-10-12, from 15:07 to about
  18:15.
* The machine was a Claude Code cloud container (Linux x64, Node v24.12.0).
* `tools/machine_profile.py --id` printed `linux:Intel(R) Xeon(R) Processor @ 2.80GHz:4cpu:16gib`, which matches the
  brief.
* `test_budget.py` printed 1, and `--mutants` printed 1, at every read.
* No timing was taken or gated on.

**Independence.** The seat is an implementer-side closing checker. It is not the item's author, a fixer or an earlier
checker of it. The round's builder is L-0469 (`build/M0-c-02-consolidate-1`). The seat's ledger row is L-0470.

**The round** is layout-plan.md R8: §1.3.1 – §1.3.9, §2's five enceinte rows and §3's `test/enceinte/` row. It changed:

* in `src/enceinte/`:
  * `plane.ts`: `segmentsCross` is now siting's `segmentsMeet` re-exported; the `TOUCH_CM` comment; the clip comment.
  * `wet.ts`: `segD2` is replaced by `distToSegment2`; header.
  * `commit.ts`: `traceWithStrips` is hoisted out of `commitS3Slice`.
  * `water.ts`: `GROUND` is now `GROUND_KEY`; comments.
  * `trace.ts` and `strips.ts`: comments only.
* in `test/enceinte/`:
  * `support.ts` gains `WALL` and `depthOf`.
  * `sides`, `chord`, `strips`, `trace` and `water` `.test.ts` import them from `support.ts`.
  * Six test headers and some in-test comments are rewritten.
* appends: C-0336, L-0469 and notes N-36 – N-41.

**How the seat worked.**

* It changed no file of the item. It wrote:
  * this file;
  * notes N-42 – N-46 of `checks/M0-c-02-notes.md`;
  * its CLEAN-ROOM row L-0470;
  * its landed records `check-M0-c-02-c1` and `check-M0-c-02-notes`;
  * its lane-log lines.
* It ran no git command of any kind.
* It planned its probes and its mutants from the brief, the plan's §1.3 oracles, the check records' mutant tables
  (`M0-c-02.md`, `-s1.md`, C-0324's Z list) and the code. Only after that did it read the builder's notes N-36 – N-41.
  The lane-log grep at the start printed the builder's CHECKPOINT and LANDED lines. The seat never opened a
  `selfcheck-*` folder or the builder's `c02-c1/` scratch files. The one exception is a hash comparison of the
  builder's `c02-c1/before/` against the seat's own before-image, made after its own image was extracted.
